name: Skeleton
description: A grey placeholder shaped like the content that is loading, so the page doesn't jump when it arrives.

variant.description: text is a line (or lines) of text, rect a block like an image, circle an avatar.

width.description: CSS width: a number is px, a string is any CSS length, e.g. '60%'. Text lines default to full width; the last of several is shorter.

height.description: CSS height. Text uses the text's line height; rect defaults to 96px.

lines.description: For text: how many lines to draw.

requirements: It is hidden from assistive technology (aria-hidden): there is nothing to read
Mark the loading region with aria-busy="true" and tell screen readers it is loading with a visually hidden status message
The pulse animation stops for people who prefer reduced motion
screenReader: Skeletons themselves are silent; the loading region's status message (e.g. "Loading orders") is what is heard

use_when: Loading content whose shape is known: lists, cards, profiles
Avoiding layout shift when data arrives
avoid_when: Unknown shape or a short wait: use a spinner
Long operations with measurable progress: use Progress
anti_patterns: Skeletons that don't match the real layout
Leaving them up with no loading message for screen readers
